infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: LineGuard uses the camera to capture evidence of line cutting.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: LineGuard records audio with video evidence.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: LineGuard lets you attach existing photos or videos as evidence.
